images.name: opaque.png
images.why: solid opaque fill → every pixel alpha 255 → the alpha channel is dead weight on disk

images.name: transparent.png
images.why: opaque 192×192 content with a fully-transparent 32px margin → at least one alpha-0 pixel → the channel is in use

note: Two loose PNGs for the wasted-alpha (fully-opaque-with-alpha-channel) detector. Read at FULL resolution (NOT the 9×8 sample — one transparent pixel must not average away). opaque ⇒ opaque:true (rule wasted-alpha; diskBytesSaved = byteSize − opaque-re-encode bytes, MEASURED; NO vramBytesSaved, invariant 5); transparent ⇒ opaque:false. The disk saving is DOWNLOAD-only — the GPU still decodes to RGBA8888 and allocates the same VRAM. The opaque re-encode is the Pro fix's job (invariant 3).
